mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, label, category, jurisdiction, description, properties::text AS properties, create_time FROM kg_node WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, code, name, label, category, jurisdiction, description, properties::text AS properties, create_time FROM kg_node WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kg_node (code, name, label, category, jurisdiction, description, properties) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{label}, #{category}, #{jurisdiction}, #{description}, CAST(#{properties} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.source_id, e.target_id, s.name AS source_name, t.name AS target_name, e.relation, e.weight, e.create_time FROM kg_edge e LEFT JOIN kg_node s ON s.id = e.source_id LEFT JOIN kg_node t ON t.id = e.target_id ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kg_edge (source_id, target_id, relation, weight) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{targetId}, #{relation}, #{weight}) ON CONFLICT (source_id, target_id, relation) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kg_edge WHERE source_id = #{nodeId} OR target_id = #{nodeId}
mapper.select: SELECT category AS category, COUNT(*) AS total FROM kg_node GROUP BY category ORDER BY total DESC
SELECT code AS code, law_name AS law_name, article_no AS article_no, title AS title, jurisdiction AS jurisdiction, tags AS tags FROM legal_article ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
